sourceBaseline: 005852a2 (pushed dev commit of Fast Checks run 40232090301)
originalFailure: Fast Checks run 40232090301, job 121285779898 'Agent Tools Shard 4' (ubuntu-latest x86_64, CPython 3.12.15, the shard's one serial non-isolated worker): FAIL at line 103 after 0.66 s, event 1343 of that worker, 1648 tests, failures=1. The same case passes when the module runs alone, on this macOS host and with CPython 3.12.13.
originalFailureLogScope: Preserved failed-job log of run 40232090301 (all failed jobs); the trace is its Agent Tools Shard 4 lines 4365-4372. It also holds unrelated Agent Tools Shard 2 failures.
confirmedCause: The count was 43 before the measured invoke and 7 after it: 36 descriptors disappeared rather than leaked. With exact identities and the cyclic collector disabled inside the window, the provider operation opens and closes all of its own descriptors on this host. The 36 belonged to unrelated garbage of earlier modules in the same serial worker. test_ssh_absolute_deadline, test_ssh_automatic_key_custody and test_ssh_collector_e2big leave BoundInlineArgv plans from build_ssh_argv whose PlannedArgv custody was never closed. Each plan holds a config and a key PrivateConfigCustody: a held '/'-to-parent directory chain plus the file. The plans are reachable only from reference cycles: exception traceback and frame cycles (assertRaises contexts, and popen_ssh's E2BIG fallback, whose PrelaunchE2Big refusal keeps the original OSError traceback, its popen_ssh frame and, through f_back, the caller frame holding the SubmittedProcess), Popen.args, CompletedProcess.args and MagicMock call records. PrivateConfigCustody.__del__ closes its descriptors silently, and the log holds no ResourceWarning, so they close only when the cyclic collector reaches them. That collection runs only when allocations trigger it, here during this case's allocation-heavy invoke. A custody of a TemporaryDirectory root under the runner's TMPDIR (/tmp/vct-*/tmp) holds 6 descriptors and a config/key plan 12 (roots directly under /tmp hold fewer); 36 is consistent with three such plans still uncollected, but which owners that Linux collection finalized was not observed. Observed on this host with CPython 3.12.13 by running the shard-4 prefix in one worker and calling gc.collect() after each test: only those five cases left garbage, closing 5 to 72 descriptors, all config and key custody chains, on this host's deeper roots. Without forced collection, the same unfixed prefix entered this module with 77 descriptors open (5 when clean). An automatic generation-2 collection two cases after the CI case then closed 72 of them (64 directories, 4 .vm-hosts.local.json, 4 inert-key: four plans from test_ssh_collector_e2big roots), inside a case that has no FD window. The earlier fd checks of the module passed because no collection reached that garbage inside their windows.
fix: Each measured window uses agent_tools/tests/descriptor_window.py: it stops the automatic collector, finalizes pending cyclic garbage (gc.collect) and only then takes the baseline, records the final table, collector state and live threads before restoring the collector, and compares exact descriptor identities (S_IFMT, st_dev, st_ino) instead of a global count. A descriptor the operation keeps, a pre-existing descriptor it closes and a release left to the collector still fail. The failure prints both complete tables (fd, type, device, inode, readlink or F_GETPATH target), the opened and closed sets, the live thread names, the collector state inside the window and what the pre-baseline collection finalized; when that collection finalized earlier descriptors the window also writes one stderr line naming their kinds, even when it passes. All five measured sites use it: ready, refusal, provider/MCP transition, closure transition and checkpoint-74 population. The same window replaces the global counts of the peer modules covered by agent_tools.tests.test_descriptor_window. No product source changes.
controlledRegression: agent_tools.tests.test_ssh_direct_ended_descriptor_window runs the actual cases of this whole beforeimage and of the current module, with the real provider, TempFS custody and local consumer children. When the case's seed returns, it collects the case's own garbage and plants three real config/key PrivateConfigCustody pairs that only a reference cycle reaches, as the earlier modules leave them; the automatic collector stays off, so they are pending at the measured baseline. One full collection starts each case's measured invoke, which makes the CI timing deterministic. Unfixed: every measured site fails with 'AssertionError: N != M' where N - M is exactly the planted descriptors that collection finalized; for the CI case this is the same line-103 statement. Fixed: the window finalized them before its baseline, the in-window collection finds none and every site passes; the one window diagnostic line names exactly the planted descriptors. Fixed controls run with the automatic collector on and observe it off inside the window and restored after it; each still fails with the complete tables: a descriptor the operation keeps open, a real cyclic custody created inside the window, and a pre-existing descriptor the operation closes.
failingEvidence: Unfixed: all five beforeimage sites fail with the count difference equal to the planted custody descriptors (54 on this macOS host's /var/folders roots; 36 expected under the CI runner's TMPDIR depth).
passingEvidence: Fixed: all five current sites pass under the same planted garbage and in-window collection; the module passes alone with CPython 3.14.3 and 3.12.13 on this host. With the real producer instead (test_ssh_collector_e2big's popen case run first in the same process, leaving 18 cyclic custody descriptors on this host) and one collection inside the measured invoke, the unfixed case failed '24 != 6' and the fixed case passed on both interpreters.
routineSuite: agent_tools.tests.test_ssh_direct_ended_descriptor_window runs in the affected agent-test stage of the managed pre-push tier and the Fast Checks agent shards whenever the selector reaches it, including changes to test_ssh_direct_ended_source_transition.py, descriptor_window.py, private_config_custody.py, this beforeimage or this provenance.
nativeEvidenceLimit: Hosted-runner test-harness measurement only; no SSH, VM, guest or product native behavior is involved or claimed. Which owners the Linux collection finalized is inferred, not observed: 36 is consistent with three config/key plans at the runner's TMPDIR depth, from the trace, the runner's fixture-root layout and this host's per-test collection census. Only a Linux Fast Checks run can show the fixed case green in the same shard order.
